mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) consistently compresses equity discount rates, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days across all economic regimes.
failure_condition: The 5-day forward return is negative in more than 55% of instances when FEDFUNDS is below 1.0%, or the Rank IC over 5-year rolling windows is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) exceeding 0.5 percentage points over three months signals deteriorating labor market conditions, triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward return is positive in more than 55% of instances when UNRATE rises > 0.5pp in 3 months, or the Rank IC over 5-year rolling windows is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates robust consumer demand, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days through improved corporate earnings expectations.
failure_condition: The interaction effect is not significant (p>0.05) or the Rank IC for the joint signal is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During late-cycle expansions, a rising industrial production (INDPRO) signals sustained manufacturing strength, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as the economy approaches peak activity.
failure_condition: In the late-cycle expansion regime, INDPRO growth does not produce positive 60-day returns in more than 55% of cases, or the Rank IC falls below 0.05 over 5-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: Strong quarterly GDP growth (GDPC1) consistently correlates with positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days, reflecting the positive impact of economic expansion on corporate profits.
failure_condition: The 60-day forward return is negative in more than 55% of instances when GDPC1 growth is positive (above 1.0% annualized), or the Rank IC over 5-year rolling windows is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly inflation rate increase (CPIAUCSL) exceeding 0.5 percentage points signals potential monetary tightening, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward return is positive in more than 55% of instances when CPIAUCSL rises > 0.5% MoM, or the Rank IC over 5-year rolling windows is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in employment (PAYEMS) and decrease in unemployment (UNRATE) indicates a strong labor market, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days through elevated consumer spending.
failure_condition: The interaction effect is not significant (p>0.05) or the Rank IC for the joint signal is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In periods of high labor market tightness (defined by UNRATE below 4.5%), the unemployment rate serves as a leading indicator of strong economic conditions, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: In the high labor market tightness regime (UNRATE < 4.5%), the 60-day forward return is negative in more than 55% of cases, or the Rank IC falls below 0.05 over 5-year windows.
